findings.description: ExactToken.pull(address,address,uint256) (src/libraries/ExactToken.sol#11-18) uses arbitrary from in transferFrom: IERC20(token).safeTransferFrom(from,address(this),amount) (src/libraries/ExactToken.sol#15)
findings.rationale: ExactToken.pull is an internal exact-delta primitive, not an exposed arbitrary-victim debit endpoint. The new executor supplies only the fixed Vault; Entry uses msg.sender; ledger/converter paths use their authenticated caller/module. Authorization and exact before/after token deltas constrain each external caller. Actual token implementation and transfer behavior remain deployment qualification, not proved by this detector review.

findings.description:
ZZZRewards._claim(uint256,address,address) (src/ZZZRewards.sol#160-174) sends eth to arbitrary user
	Dangerous calls:
	- (ok,None) = owner.call{value: amount}() (src/ZZZRewards.sol#171)
findings.rationale: Rewards._claim checks the current NFT owner or fixed claim-router forwarding, checkpoints, and clears personal/collective accrual and liability before paying the authorized recipient. External wrappers are nonReentrant and economic lifecycle guarded; the reported arbitrary ETH destination is the intended owner payment.

findings.description:
ZZZFeeController._push(address,address,uint256) (src/ZZZFeeController.sol#43-49) sends eth to arbitrary user
	Dangerous calls:
	- (ok,None) = address(destination).call{value: amount}() (src/ZZZFeeController.sol#47)
findings.rationale: FeeController._push is private. Its callers choose the fixed Rewards, Vault or Buyback module, not an arbitrary user recipient, and decrement/clear the classified reserve before transfer. Exact raw balance deltas detect a failed or unexpected transfer. This does not make arbitrary governance replacement code safe.

findings.description:
ZZZRoyaltyRewards._claim(uint256,address,address) (src/ZZZRoyaltyRewards.sol#310-331) sends eth to arbitrary user
	Dangerous calls:
	- (success,None) = address(owner).call{value: amount}() (src/ZZZRoyaltyRewards.sol#321)
findings.rationale: Royalty _claim authenticates current owner/router, synchronizes/checkpoints, clears accrual and liability/accounted backing before external payout. Its nonReentrant wrapper and final backing checks prevent a receiver callback from claiming the same accrual twice. Returned native currency is handled as a subsequent receipt.

findings.description:
ZZZRewardConverter._convertV4(address,uint256,bytes32,uint256,uint256) (src/base/ZZZRewardConverter.sol#205-227) sends eth to arbitrary user
	Dangerous calls:
	- (ok,None) = address(ledger).call{value: output}() (src/base/ZZZRewardConverter.sol#223)
findings.rationale: Converter is nonReentrant, live/operating, and callable only by its immutable ledger. It pulls an exact source amount, uses an admitted typed route and captured execution floor, resets approval and measures exact source/output native deltas. Native output goes to that ledger. Callback authorization and final raw balances were inspected; a malicious qualified venue/token or false admitted prices remain explicit external trust/qualification risks.

findings.description:
Reentrancy in ZZZVault._receiveVenue(uint256,uint256,uint8) (src/ZZZVault.sol#365-386):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- manager.close(p.poolId,p.lpTokenId,deadline) (src/ZZZVault.sol#373)
	Balance read before the call:
	- before1 = _tokenBalance(token1) (src/ZZZVault.sol#369)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- token0 == address(0) && amount0 != nativeReceived - received (src/ZZZVault.sol#377)
		- stale variable `token0`
findings.rationale: These private helpers run only through guarded Vault financial entrypoints. _balanceUsing spends bounded attributed amounts and checks exact returns; _receiveVenue accepts only the fixed Manager route and distinguishes actual received native credit from a raw ETH balance. Operation 0 allocates fees, 1 closes the complete portfolio, 2 closes only residual; a residual-only close does not clear the main LP ID. Post-callback accounting and idle backing are rechecked. canonicalWrite requires the fixed companion and inert canonical state, so it is not a token-reentry writer during normal operating calls.

findings.description:
Reentrancy in ZZZLiquidityManager.balance(bytes32,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256) (src/ZZZLiquidityManager.sol#234-293):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- p = balancingRouter.planReplacement(targetPool,lower,upper,amount0,amount1,10000,marks) (src/ZZZLiquidityManager.sol#267-268)
	Balance read before the call:
	- tokenPrefund = IERC20(target.key.currency1).balanceOf(address(this)) (src/ZZZLiquidityManager.sol#242)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- address(this).balance != nativePrefund || IERC20(target.key.currency1).balanceOf(address(this)) != tokenPrefund || _balanceContext(targetPool) != context (src/ZZZLiquidityManager.sol#287-288)
		- stale variable `tokenPrefund`
findings.rationale: Manager.balance and Vault entry wrappers are nonReentrant. Balancing pulls only the explicit budget before quote, and the fixed Balancer performs hookless core quotes which revert all core effects without token settlement or recipients. Exact prefund/output/context checks after refund intentionally compare against the captured balances; Vault intentionally retains pre-entry supply while checkpointing fees. New actual-tick ranking adds no mutable caller or fund authority. Token/dependency authenticity and actual operating economics remain qualification.

findings.rationale: Activate/increase are economic/principal operating and nonReentrant entrypoints. Contribution identity/ownership is captured, incumbent fees are checkpointed and only entrant funds can meet marginal deployment floors. Exact added LP and post-operation aggregate NAV determine shares; accrued incumbent reward/compound cannot subsidize the entrant. Membership activation calls only fixed ledgers and rechecks operation invariants; callbacks cannot enter another guarded join or canonical writer.

findings.rationale:
count<=Vault.MAX_BUCKETS=4 is checked. Two fixed current pair currencies per relevant bucket; after compositionEpoch!=0, admitted LP reward currencies explicitly<=33. At most33 unique currencies per bucket and132 flush calls across4 buckets, because the current pair is excluded from the historical-asset loop.
Only bound Vault invokes this economic operation. Snapshot bucket count cannot grow by outside reentry while its Vault contribution is nonreentrant. get/group/epoch/asset reads are static. Fee.flushDust is mutable and independently nonreentrant; it clears dust before credit, requires Vault/Membership and valid bucket status, and preserves canonicalAccounting pre/post checks. Rewards transfers are exact, liabilities updated and backed. A malicious admitted token could revert; it cannot select a new array or receive a sweep.
Bounded incumbent settlement, not an unbounded per-NFT harvest. Funded broken-token dust can block entry atomically; zero dust returns before token handling. Qualify maximum historical-asset gas and exact token behavior.

findings.description:

findings.description:

findings.description:

findings.rationale:
Prior assets length<=33 by both capture/import headers; deleting accepted flags is<=33 storage writes. New groups<=4 and lpAssets in1..33. New asset arrays replace prior arrays, not append across attempts.

The one costly-loop record is a bounded reset of<=33flags, not unbounded state growth. Worst-case cold flags/full33asset balances and failed optional assets remain gas/availability qualification.
